audience: event organizers who sell tickets and manage registrations in Eventzilla

useCases.title: See your events with tickets sold
useCases.text: The AI lists your events with dates, venue, status, tickets sold and total, and opens one for its details. You see how sales are going.

useCases.title: List the attendees of an event
useCases.text: The AI lists the attendees of one event with ticket type, check-in status, order reference and answers to registration questions. You can prepare a guest list.

useCases.title: Review the orders of an event
useCases.text: The AI lists the orders of one event with order reference, date, amount, number of tickets and status, and opens one order. You can sum up sales.

useCases.title: Check ticket types, prices and sales windows
useCases.text: The AI lists the ticket types of an event with price, quantity, sales window and limits, and the donation options. You can compare tickets.

useCases.title: Open or close ticket sales for an event
useCases.text: The AI publishes or unpublishes ticket sales for one event. When sales are off, attendees cannot buy tickets on the event page.
